1. Overview
Muno is a cross-platform mobile application that connects customers with savings from local businesses.
Members browse offers, saving alerts and loyalty rewards from participating brands, find them on a map,
save the ones they like and redeem them in store, all from an Android or iOS phone.
The app also alerts members when they are near a participating location, lets them load and manage a
Syngillions e-gift card, share the app with friends and merchants, and ask questions through an AI chat
assistant. Content, customer accounts, offers and redemptions are held on the server and reached
through a secured Web API.
The application is built on .NET 9 and .NET MAUI using the MVVM pattern, and talks to an ASP.NET
Core Web API backed by SQL Server. It is available in English and Spanish.
2. Business Context
Local savings and rewards programmes typically need to:

• Give consumers one place to discover offers, saving alerts and loyalty rewards from nearby
businesses
• Help businesses reach customers at the right moment, for example when they are close to a location
• Make redemption simple and verifiable at the point of sale, without paper coupons
• Grow the member base through referrals and merchant recommendations
• Support members in more than one language and more than one country
• Offer a stored-value option, such as an e-gift card, that can be used across partner shopping sites
Muno brings these needs into one mobile app, backed by a central service that manages brands,
locations, offers, customers and notifications.

4. Functional Modules
4.1 Account Creation & Secure Login

• New members join with name, email, country code and phone, password, zip code, birth and
anniversary month, an optional referral code and opt-ins for mailing list, SMS redemption links and
push

• A validation code confirms the account; sign-in uses email and password and returns a token used for
all protected requests

• Face ID or fingerprint sign-in can be enabled by the member; forgot-password sends a reset code,
then a new password is set
4.2 Offers, Saving Alerts & Loyalty Rewards

• Brands are listed with their offers, saving alerts and loyalty rewards, loaded in pages and grouped by
category
• A member can subscribe to or unsubscribe from a location to follow its offers
• Location and offer details show the merchant, terms, images and the settings that apply to redemption
4.3 Explore Map, Search & Filters

• The Explore screen shows participating locations as map pins, with search, Directions and Call
actions and a shortcut to Saved Offer and View Offer

• Filter and sort options cover location and merchant, category and country, and a Clear Filter action
resets them

• Distances can be shown in kilometres, and the map uses Google Maps on Android and the native
map on iOS
4.4 Saved Offers & In-Store Redemption

• Offers can be saved, marked as favourites and loaded; the app checks that an offer is valid and
redeemable before redemption

• Depending on the offer’s settings, the member is asked for a clerk ID, a PIN or the gross sale amount,
which is compared with the minimum purchase
• Redeemed offers are recorded and listed in Redemption History
4.5 Location Alerts (Geofencing)

• The app watches a 300-metre area around the member and, when they leave it, monitors the nearest
merchant locations (up to 19, 100-metre radius each)

• On entering a merchant’s area the app fetches its details and, if coupons are available, shows a
notification with the offer

• On Android a foreground location service with background location permission keeps monitoring
running; iOS uses its own geofence worker
4.6 Syngillions E-Gift Card & Payments

• An information page explains the Syngillions gift card and its use on the Syngillions shopping site, and
a card number page shows the member’s card

• The card is loaded with a saved credit card and billing address, with amount selection and an Auto
Load setting for automatic reloads

• The card can be added to the phone wallet through a generated download link, and its transactions
are listed
4.7 Notifications, Referrals & Partner Sites

• A notifications list shows messages and offers from the server, with mark-as-read and delete actions
and a detail page for each

• Members can refer friends with a personal referral link, refer merchants through a business
information form and share a review on Facebook

• Friends of Synergy, vortex shopping, the Syngillions shop, FAQ and About Us open as in-app web
pages
4.8 Access Plans, AI Assistant & Settings

• The access plan screen offers a Free Pass for six months or a Premium plan at $9.99 per month, with
a Restore Purchases option; a store billing service is included for Android and iOS

• The AI chat assistant sends the member’s message and a session ID to a chat service and shows the
reply in a conversation view

• Settings cover change password, English or Spanish language and the distance unit; Contact Us
sends an email to support

6. System Architecture & Integrations
The solution contains the mobile app and a server-side service, connected over HTTPS:

• Mobile app: SdMAUI, a single .NET MAUI project with XAML pages, MVVM view models, custom
map and entry controls, and service classes for authentication, brands, offers, notifications, pages,
billing and geofencing

• Web API: iTabula.SynergyApp.MobileAppService, an ASP.NET Core Web API with Account, Brands,
Customer, Locations, Notifications, Offers and Regions controllers, JWT bearer authentication and
Swagger; the app calls it through a generated Swagger client

• Data: Entity Framework Core on SQL Server with a unit-of-work pattern, covering brands, merchants,
locations, offers, customers, notifications, referrals, subscriptions and white-label settings; the app
also keeps a local SQLite cache of offers

• Synergy web service: a connected SOAP service used for gift card and payment operations such as
loading the Syngillions card

• Location and maps: Shiny geofencing, Google Maps on Android, the native map on iOS, and a
Haversine helper in the Web API for distance calculations

• Other services: an AI chat service, Google Play Billing and StoreKit for purchases, and partner web
pages for shopping and information

8. Security & Data Handling

• The Web API issues JWT bearer tokens and validates issuer, audience, lifetime and signing key; offer,
notification and region endpoints require authentication

• Customers are managed with ASP.NET Identity using a custom password hasher, and unique email
addresses are required
• Face ID and fingerprint sign-in is an option the member can turn on in the app
• Requests use HTTPS, and the service redirects HTTP traffic to HTTPS

• Background location is used only for location alerts, with the required permissions and a visible
foreground-service notification on Android

• Payment details are sent to the Synergy web service for gift card loading rather than processed on the
device

• Offers are cached locally in SQLite to speed up display; customer and redemption records stay on the
server
9. Value Delivered
• Gives members one app to discover, save and redeem local offers
• Reaches members at the right moment with alerts when they are near a participating location
• Replaces paper coupons with checked, recorded in-store redemptions
• Grows the community through referrals, merchant recommendations and review sharing
• Serves English and Spanish speakers with a single app
• Adds a stored-value option through the Syngillions e-gift card and its partner shop
• Runs on the current .NET 9 MAUI stack for both Android and iOS
